notes: C++ shows 'Selected: Image' at top while MAUI shows 'Selected: -' — this is runtime interaction state difference, not a rendering bug.
C++ light renders the green rounded rectangle with visible red corner squares at its bounds, indicating the hit-test bounding box is drawn/exposed; MAUI does not show these red corners.
The red corner indicators in C++ (visible at all four corners of the green box) suggest the C++ port is rendering an additional debug bounding box element that MAUI does not show.
Both themes show the same content otherwise (ellipse ring, scaled label, rotated italic label, green rounded box); dark mode reproduces the same red-corner difference.
